scope: Runtime preparation (private header, inline namespace, extracted handlers): every profile/mode compiles, fast lane builds and boots.
claims: runtime.cpp compiles for all ten profiles in debug, release and both private-fixture configurations
x86_64, arm32 and ppc debug kernels pass xmake test

sources.relation: blob-identical to the commit (every tracked file)

environment.xmake: xmake v3.1.1+HEAD.3ba37a0, A cross-platform build utility based on Lua
environment.systoolchain: SysToolchain 0.1.0 release archives (one per triple), installed with --systoolchain_dir

commands.label: compile src/user/runtime.cpp (all)
commands.command: for mode in release,debug; for each profile: <compile-flags.json[<mode>-<profile>]> -fsyntax-only <each of src/user/runtime.cpp>  # run from the tree root

commands.label: compile src/user/runtime.cpp (signal-fixture)
commands.command: for mode in debug; for each profile: <compile-flags.json[<mode>-<profile>]> -DOK_PRIVATE_SIGNAL_DELIVERY_FIXTURE -fsyntax-only <each of src/user/runtime.cpp>  # run from the tree root

commands.label: compile src/user/runtime.cpp (futex-fixture)
commands.command: for mode in debug; for each profile: <compile-flags.json[<mode>-<profile>]> -DOK_PRIVATE_FUTEX_PEER_FIXTURE -fsyntax-only <each of src/user/runtime.cpp>  # run from the tree root

commands.label: kernel debug x86_64
commands.command: cd <tree> && xmake f -c -y -m debug -a x86_64 --systoolchain_dir=<systoolchain>/x86_64-elf --qemu_binary=<systoolchain>/x86_64-elf/bin/qemu-system-x86_64 && xmake -y -j 6 -b okernel_image && xmake test

commands.label: kernel debug arm32
commands.command: cd <tree> && xmake f -c -y -m debug -a arm32 --systoolchain_dir=<systoolchain>/arm-none-eabi --qemu_binary=<systoolchain>/arm-none-eabi/bin/qemu-system-arm && xmake -y -j 6 -b okernel_image && xmake test

commands.label: kernel debug ppc
commands.command: cd <tree> && xmake f -c -y -m debug -a ppc --systoolchain_dir=<systoolchain>/powerpc-eabi --qemu_binary=<systoolchain>/powerpc-eabi/bin/qemu-system-ppc && xmake -y -j 6 -b okernel_image && xmake test
